overview_description.description: FalconViz is set to deliver digital transformation at scale in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabis. As an intelligence company founded in patented technological advancements developed at KAUST from 2014, we are the kingdom’s experts in developing state-of-the-art solutions to rapidly digitize invaluable assets across geospatial, inspection, climate and cultural heritage market sectors. We uniquely are able to fill the technological gaps of digital transformation through the deployment of our fleet of aerial drones, terrestrial scanning systems, cyber-secure data center and team of specialized geo-engineers and spatial computing experts. By providing turn-key AI and software solutions, we extract intelligence from our clients’ digitized assets enabling them to advance their digitization and intelligence capabilities and make strategic decisions in real-time.

product.name: Construction Monitoring and Verification
product.description: Service that uses UAVs and related equipment to monitor and verify construction projects, ensuring accurate progress tracking and quality control.

product.name: Pre-Construction Topographic Surveying and Mapping
product.description: Service providing detailed topographic surveys and mapping using UAVs and laser scanning to support pre-construction planning and site feasibility studies.

product.name: Asset Digitization
product.description: Service that digitally documents physical assets using UAVs, laser scanning, and 3D modeling to create accurate digital representations.

product.name: Infrastructure Inspection
product.description: Inspection service using drones equipped with visual and thermal sensors to assess the condition of infrastructure assets.

product.name: Aerial Videography and Photography
product.description: Service providing aerial video and photographic capture using drones for media production and documentation purposes.

product.name: 3D Terrestrial Laser Scanning
product.description: Service that captures precise 3D spatial data of environments and structures using terrestrial laser scanning technology.
